# netbox_event_rule (Resource)

Manages a NetBox event rule (`/api/extras/event-rules/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_event_rule" "example" {
  object_types = []
  name = "example"
  event_types = []
  action_type = "webhook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_type` (String) Action Type. Valid values: `webhook`, `script`, `notification`.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The types of event which will trigger this rule. Valid values: `object_created`, `object_updated`, `object_deleted`, `job_started`, `job_completed`, `job_failed`, `job_errored`.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.

### Optional

- `action_object_id` (Number) Action Object Id.
- `action_object_type` (String) Action Object Type.
- `conditions` (String) A set of conditions which determine whether the event will be generated.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_event_rule can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_event_rule.example 123
```
